title: I built and published an iOS puzzle game mostly using AI looking for feedback
author: Careless_Original978
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I recently launched my first iOS game, **Dolly Animal Blocks Puzzle**.

The game is a casual animal-themed block puzzle where players solve increasingly challenging levels using cute animal pieces.

What makes this project interesting is that I used AI heavily during development:

* AI-assisted coding
* AI-generated art/assets (with editing and refinement)
* AI help for game design ideas
* AI-assisted App Store assets and descriptions

App Store:  
[Dolly Animal Blocks Puzzle](https://apps.apple.com/app/dolly-animal-blocks-puzzle/id6772571197?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

I'd love feedback from other AI game developers:

* What parts of the game feel AI-generated vs. handcrafted?
* What would you improve first?
* Any advice on marketing an AI-built mobile game?

Happy to answer questions about the tools and workflow I used.
